record.paper_title: Some open problems in the context of skew PBW extensions and semi-graded rings
record.original_question: If B is a left semi-graded Artin-Schelter regular algebra (SAS) with finite Gelfand-Kirillov dimension, must B be a left noetherian domain?

evidence.quote: • Is any SAS algebra with finite GKdim a left noetherian domain?

Remark 4.15. From the general homological properties of skew P BW extensions we know that if R is a noetherian domain, then A is a noetherian domain ([38]). This agrees with the question of Problem 4.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $B$ be an associative $\mathbb{K}$-algebra over a field $\mathbb{K}$. We say $B$ is left semi-graded if there exists an ascending filtration $\{B_n\}_{n\geq 0}$ of $\mathbb{K}$-subspaces with $B_0 = \mathbb{K}$, $B = \bigcup_{n\geq 0} B_n$, $B_m \cdot B_n \subseteq B_{m+n}$, and each $B_n$ finite-dimensional, where the associated graded structure need not be connected graded in the classical sense (so the multiplication of homogeneous components $B_n^{sg} := B_n/B_{n-1}$ may include lower-degree contributions). Define the Gelfand–Kirillov (GK) dimension of $B$ in the usual way via $\mathrm{GKdim}(B) = \limsup_{n\to\infty} \log_n \dim_{\mathbb{K}} B_n$. 

A left semi-graded algebra $B$ is called left semi-graded Artin–Schelter regular (left SAS regular) if:
(i) $B$ has finite left global dimension $d$;
(ii) $\mathrm{Ext}^i_B(\mathbb{K}, B) = 0$ for $i \neq d$ and $\mathrm{Ext}^d_B(\mathbb{K}, B) \cong \mathbb{K}$ (Gorenstein-type condition adapted to the semi-graded setting), where $\mathbb{K}$ denotes the trivial left $B$-module $B/B_{>0}$.

Question: If $B$ is a left SAS regular algebra with $\mathrm{GKdim}(B) < \infty$, must $B$ be a left noetherian domain?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in the context of semi-graded rings and skew PBW extensions. Web searches turn up no published proof or counterexample resolving whether every left SAS regular algebra of finite GK dimension is a left noetherian domain; partial results exist for skew PBW extensions over noetherian domains, but the general semi-graded SAS case appears unresolved.

status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly stated as open.

status_evidence.title: Artin–Schelter regular algebras and categories
status_evidence.snippet: Connected graded noetherian AS-regular algebras of low global dimension are known to be domains, but the semi-graded analogue is not addressed.
status_evidence.claim: Existing AS-regular results are in the connected graded setting; the semi-graded version is not covered.
